description: A PNG of the page as loaded, or as seen through one of pour's simulations, the same ones the extension ships. Vision: cataract (Clouded Lens), presbyopia (Near-Vision Loss), lowAcuityMild (Slight Defocus), lowAcuity (Uncorrected Focus), lowAcuityStrong (Significant Defocus), lowAcuityHeavy (Severe Defocus), lowLight (Dim Environment), lowContrast (Reduced Contrast), retinitisRing (Ring Loss), glaucoma (Tunnel Vision), glaucomaLarge (Tunnel Vision (Large)), macularDegeneration (Central Vision Loss), macularDegenerationLarge (Central Vision Loss (Large)), diabeticRetinopathy (Patchy Vision), nystagmus (Involuntary Eye Movement), hemianopiaLeft (Left Field Loss), hemianopiaRight (Right Field Loss), amblyopia (Reduced Acuity (One Eye)), afterimages (Afterimages), ageSlider (Age Slider), scotopicRose (Rose Tint), scotopicYellow (Yellow Tint), scotopicAqua (Aqua Tint), protanopia (Red Absent (Protanopia)), deuteranopia (Green Absent (Deuteranopia)), tritanopia (Blue Absent (Tritanopia)), achromatopsia (Monochromacy), protanomaly (Red Deficiency), deuteranomaly (Green Deficiency), tritanomaly (Blue Deficiency). Sensory, motor and structure: lightSensitivity (Light Sensitivity (Metaphor)), colourHypersensitivity (Colour Hypersensitivity (Metaphor)), motionSensitivity (Motion Sensitivity (Metaphor)), hyperfocusTunnel (Hyperfocus Tunnel (Metaphor)), attentionFragmentation (Attention Fragmentation (Metaphor)), peripheralDistraction (Peripheral Distraction (Metaphor)), detailFixation (Detail Fixation (Metaphor)), processingDelay (Processing Lag (Metaphor)), sensoryInterference (Sensory Interference (Metaphor)), sensorySpike (Sudden Sensory Spike (Metaphor)), dyslexiaVisualStress (Visual Stress (Pattern Glare) (Metaphor)), dyslexiaCrowding (Crowding Effect), dyslexiaTrackingLoss (Tracking Loss (Metaphor)), dyslexiaWashout (Letter Instability (Metaphor)), dyslexiaContrastSensitivity (Contrast Sensitivity), handTremor (Hand Tremor), handTremorStrong (Hand Tremor (Strong)), restingTremor (Resting Tremor), ataxicDrift (Ataxic Drift), pointerSpasm (Sudden Jerk), pointerHidden (Hidden Pointer (Keyboard Only)), fingertipTouch (Fingertip Touch), forcedColours (Forced Colours (Windows Contrast Theme)), screenMagnifier (Screen Magnifier (400%)), textSpacing (Text Spacing), focusOrder (Focus Order), landmarkMap (Landmarks & Headings). Omit the filter for the page as it is. Useful for what the numbers cannot show: colour-vision and low-vision rendering, and the focusOrder and landmarkMap lenses drawn over the page.

filter.description: A simulation name. Omit for the plain page.

fullPage.description: Capture the full page height instead of the viewport. Long pages make large images. Default false.

insecure.description: Ignore TLS certificate errors, for a dev server with a self-signed certificate. Default false.

path.description: A file on disk to check instead of a URL, relative to the folder the server was started in. It is served over http from its own folder, so relative assets load. Give one of url or path, not both.

root.description: With path: the folder to serve as the site root, for a page whose assets are addressed from the root (/styles.css) rather than from its own folder. Defaults to the file's own folder.

scroll.description: Scroll through the page first so lazy-loaded content is in the DOM. Changes the numbers, by design. Default false.

url.description: The page to load, http or https only. A local dev server is fine (http://localhost:8080/). Without a scheme, https is tried first, then http. For a file on disk use path instead: file:// URLs are refused.

viewport.description: Viewport as WxH. Default 1440x900. Responsive pages serve different content per width, so the width is part of the result.

waitMs.description: Extra settle time after the page loads, in milliseconds. Default 0.
